title: Russian Missile Crashes in Poland During Attack on Ukraine; Tusk Calls It a Provocation
detail: A Russian missile fired during attacks on Ukraine crashed in Poland, according to BBC reporting. Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it hit as Ukraine's allies were holding a military exercise, and Warsaw called the incident a provocation. Missiles reportedly exploded miles from British troops stationed in Poland. Exact impact location not yet confirmed in the source reporting.
